newsitem.title: USA: AOL exploring CompuServe bid, newspaper reports.
newsitem.headline: AOL exploring CompuServe bid, newspaper reports.

text.p: America Online Inc is exploring a bid to buy its computer online service rival CompuServe, the Washington Post reported in its Wednesday editions.
The newspaper cited industry sources for the report. It quoted a CompuServe spokeswoman as saying she was not aware of any negotiations between the two companies and said AOL declined to comment.

Many AOL customers have been experiencing connection delays and other service problems since the company began offering online service at a flat rate rather than an hourly fee. AOL said the demand for its service grew faster than it expected and has promised to fix the problems.
